entries.title: A quieter projects list
entries.body: Settings → Projects shows your projects in one list, and each row says only what is set differently from a new project, such as merges on its own or local merge. A project's folder shows only when it sits outside your projects folder. Where new projects go is now one line under Add project.

picture.alt: Settings, Projects, one list of projects where most rows show only a name, a few show words such as merges on its own, and the projects folder sits on one line under Add project
